title: Base change of pushforward along a proper morphism without the finiteness hypotheses
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves base change for the pushforward along a proper morphism for arbitrary sheaves, with no finiteness hypothesis: g^{-1}f_*F = f'_*(g')^{-1}F (statement lines 18281-18287). The proof constructs the canonical comparison map by an adjunction computation (proof lines 18290-18297) and then checks it is an isomorphism on stalks, where the cited same-chapter description identifies the stalks with sections over the geometric fibres X'_{y'} and X_y, which coincide since X_y = X'_{y'} (proof lines 18298-18305). The non-formal point is the stalk computation through the proper pushforward description, which is exactly where properness replaces the missing finiteness hypotheses. The claim is H2: one adjunction construction plus one stalk computation, with the author's routine compatibility verification noted but not reproduced.
